module_name: Project registry work in the background
input: The QNC root and the Project form's requests: list, create, open, delete projects; list, choose, create, delete templates; the projects root.
output: The state the form shows (projects, templates, projects root) or the error, and for an opened or created project its application sequence; every request runs in one background worker owning the Project store (qnc-store-jobs), in the order sent.
specification: Audit 2026-10-25: the Project form did this work on the form thread (100-300 ms).
